summary: Clarify SM121 support and validation of the NVFP4 MTP draft head
compatibility: The opt-in NVFP4 draft head accepts SM120-family GPUs. The default BF16 head is unchanged.
details: Corrects vllm-995: the draft head selects FlashInfer's CuTe-DSL W4A16 backend, which explicitly supports SM120 and SM121 through architecture-specific CuTe compilation; this path does not depend on a 12.0f CUDA build target.
The reported GB10 test covers weight quantization and packing. GB10 draft logits, CUDA graph replay, and model serving remain unverified.

On SM120, the draft-head forward tests pass for single-row and multi-row inputs against independently dequantized NVFP4 weights, including CUDA graph replay with changed inputs and stable allocated memory. Validation used FlashInfer 0.6.18+lil.cu134.sm120.g34426e96c02c and CUTLASS DSL 4.7.1.
